[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. **Vegan Mac and Cheese**: Made with vegan macaroni, non-dairy milk, and vegan cheeses.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. **Black Bean and Sweet Potato Enchiladas**: Sweet potatoes and black beans wrapped in tortillas with enchilada sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. **Thai Red Curry**: Made with red curry paste, coconut milk, and protein like tofu or tempeh.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. **Roasted Vegetable Soup**: Made with roasted vegetables blended with vegetable broth.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. **Vegan Butter Chickpeas**: Chickpeas in a tomato-based sauce with vegan butter.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. **Jamaican Jerk Lentils**: Lentils cooked in jerk seasoning-infused broth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] These recipes are easy to make and require minimal prep time.
